name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A person or thing as an image with an initials fallback.
a11y: name is required: it is the image alt text and the fallback's accessible name.
The fallback shows while the image loads or if it fails.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. If it fails or is missing, the initials show.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's name. Used as the image alt text and to make initials; required so it always has a name.

props.name: variant
props.description: `solid` (default) fills the circle; `line` draws only an outline.

usage: import {Avatar} from '@monoline/react';
